about: detect_sensitive patterns for import format v1. Loaded by backend/app/importer/sanitize.py and schema/check_run.py. Text is normalized first (see normalize). Rules then run in this order on every scanned text field and key. Rules with masked=true run on the normalized text after the masks below are replaced by an underscore. A rule with sections runs only on text in those snapshot sections, never on other sections, CSV rows or other callers. booking-code covers rewards and trips (from 1.3) and flags, installment_plans and goals (from 1.4, redaction.json version 4; the app checks these sections in runs of every version).

normalize.about: Before any rule or private-list match: Unicode NFKC, then every non-ASCII decimal digit becomes its ASCII digit, every dash (category Pd and U+2212) becomes '-', every other space character becomes ' ', and format characters (category Cf, such as zero-width spaces) are removed. So full-width digits, no-break spaces and en dashes cannot hide a number.

private.about: Private lists (personal subscription names, employer terms) match case-insensitively as substrings. Both sides are lowercased and every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 becomes one space. A term also matches when its letters and digits alone (all else removed) appear in the text's letters and digits alone, if that form has at least min_squashed characters.

rules.about: Digit groups of 2 or more joined by spaces (any number), or by one dot or dash with optional spaces around it.

Digit groups joined by gaps of 1 to 3 characters that are not letters or digits. Any window of consecutive groups with min_digits to max_digits digits that passes the Luhn check is a hit. A gap that is not one tight_gap character only joins groups of at least loose_min_group digits.

Rewards and trips (from 1.3) and flags, installment_plans and goals (from 1.4; the app checks these sections in runs of every version), plan component merchants included. A case-sensitive token of 6 to 8 capital letters and digits, with at least 2 of each: record locators, confirmation codes, claim and order numbers, and flight numbers like two letters and four digits. Codes made only of letters are not caught.

stock_plan.about: Applies to holding names. A match rejects the run.
